title: Mind the Intent Gap: A Methodology for Collaborative Agent-Driven Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.37340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents have entered software teams, first as tools and now as team members. They produce in minutes what used to take days, yet the expected gain in delivery often fails to appear. We argue that they are entering processes designed for people, which quietly relied on people to cover three of their weaknesses. The team's intent was never fully written down, because colleagues filled the gaps. An AI agent fills them too, though by guessing, and drifts from what the team had in mind. The reasoning behind each deliverable was already lost from one step to the next, and AI agents now inflate and deflate the documents passed along. The reasoning people did alone was partly private and now moves into AI tools that keep it private by nature. We present CAIA, for Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment, a methodology for software teams that brings agents into the way they work. A knowledge base describes the product that a project maintains. Fo

translated_title: 注意意图差距：一种协作式智能体驱动的软件工程方法论
translated_abstract: AI智能体已进入软件团队，最初作为工具，如今则作为团队成员。它们能在几分钟内完成过去需要数天的工作，然而预期的交付收益却往往未能实现。我们认为，这是因为它们进入的是为人设计的流程，而这些流程一直悄然依赖于人来弥补自身的三个弱点。团队的意图从未被完整地记录下来，因为同事之间会自然填补这些空白；AI智能体同样会填补这些空白，但只能靠猜测，从而偏离了团队原本的想法。每个交付物背后的推理过程在流程步骤之间早已丢失，而AI智能体现在会放大或压缩传递的文档。人们独自完成的推理有一部分是私密性的，如今这些推理转移到了天然将其保持私密的AI工具之中。我们提出了CAIA（Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment，协作式智能体意图对齐），这是一种将智能体融入软件团队工作方式的方法论。该方法通过一个知识库来描述项目所维护的产品。
tldr: 提出CAIA（协作式智能体意图对齐）方法论，通过知识库显式记录团队意图，弥合AI智能体加入软件团队后因“意图未被完整记录”而靠猜测行事并偏离团队目标的“意图差距”问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes CAIA (Collaborative Agentic Intent Alignment), a methodology that bridges the "intent gap" arising when AI agents join software teams, using a knowledge base to explicitly capture team intent that was previously carried implicitly by human colleagues.
